name: gdc-wcdt-mcrpc
alternateName: Genomic Characterization of Metastatic Castration Resistant Prostate Cancer
description:
The West Coast Dream Team cohort is one of the few public resources that sequences metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer tissue rather than primary tumor, which is what makes it valuable: the biology that drives lethal prostate cancer is not well represented in primary-tumor cohorts. All 101 cases carry whole genome sequencing with copy number and structural variant calls, and 99 carry RNA sequencing.
The clinical annotation is unusual in shape. Disease state is recorded with complete consistency - every case is AJCC stage IV, every case has progression or recurrence recorded as "yes", and every case's last known disease status is distant metastatic recurrence or progression. But vital status is "unknown" for all 101 cases, and no treatment field is populated. The cohort tells you precisely where these patients were in their disease course and nothing about what happened to them next.
citeAs: Genomic correlates of clinical outcome in advanced prostate cancer

supportedQuestions: What distinguishes the genome of metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer from primary prostate cancer?
Which transcriptional programs mark androgen receptor pathway independence and neuroendocrine transdifferentiation in treatment-resistant disease?
How do structural variants and genome rearrangement patterns differ between metastatic sites?
Can expression or genomic features predict which metastatic biopsies come from patients with the most aggressive disease trajectory?

blockingLimitations.statement: Vital status is populated for all 101 cases and informative for none - every value is "unknown". No overall survival endpoint exists in the harmonized records, despite a follow-up time being derivable for 87 of 101 cases with a median of 95 months.

No treatment field is populated: treatment type, therapeutic agents, treatment outcome and line of therapy are all empty. These are castration-resistant patients, so every one has had prior androgen deprivation and most will have had further systemic therapy, but which therapy and in what order is not recorded here.

inappropriateUses: Survival analysis or prognostic biomarker discovery from the GDC records.
Attributing resistance mechanisms to particular drugs.
